title: ETH Zurich, Department of Information Technology and Electrical Engineering - Shape the future – dedicated to world-class research and education in Information Technology and Electrical Engineering
description:
Overview:
The Department of Information Technology and Electrical Engineering (D-ITET) includes 19 research laboratories (institutes) with activities ranging from integrated circuits to computer networks, from wireless communications to signal processing, and from control theory to power electronics. In addition, we have strong research units in biomedical engineering and in neural information processing. The D-ITET offers a Bachelor's/Master programme in Electrical Engineering and Information Technology. We also offer several interdisciplinary Master's programmes.

title: Bachelor Electrical Engineering and Information Technology | ETH Zurich
description: # Bachelor Electrical Engineering and Information Technology. Mathematics, physics and computer science form the basis of the diverse toolbox used by electrical engineers to invent, develop and build the technology of the future. By studying Electrical Engineering and Information Technology, students will gain the theoretical foundations and practical skills they need to build a successful career in a wide range of different fields relating to information processing, electronics, energy supply and biomedical engineering. Thanks to the versatility of the ETH programmes, their professional skills are also in demand not just in areas such as the aviation and automotive industries, but also in public companies and the service sector. In the third year of the programme, Electrical Engineering and Information Technology students can specialise in a focus area and supplement this with electives. A Bachelor’s thesis completes the programme. The Master’s degree programme also includes a semester paper and an (optional) industrial placement, and is completed with a six-month Master’s thesis.

title: Bachelor's Programme – Dept. of Information Technology and Electrical Engineering | ETH Zurich
description: of Information Technology and Electrical Engineering. # Bachelor's Programme. The Bachelor's programme in Electrical Engineering and Information Technology is a three-year full-time study programme that primarily prepares students for the subsequent Master's programme. In addition, the Bachelor's programme also enables students to continue their studies by transferring to one of our interdisciplinary Master's programmes. The language of instruction in the Bachelor's programme is German. In the first two years of the programme, almost all courses are compulsory. The standard duration of the Bachelor's programme is three years (full-time). In the first two years, almost all subjects are compulsory; in the third year there is great freedom of choice.
